legend-lake-thun-and-lauterbrunnen-route.story: curated scenic road. lake, waterfalls, Bernese Alps. A one-way ride of 34 km, Thun to Lauterbrunnen - roughly 37 min in the saddle. The stops in between: Spiez and Interlaken. The highest point is about 2,150 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Thun and Lauterbrunnen Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 9 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
